name: Vault MCP
description: Audited agent access to your vault: an embedded MCP server with direct app.* access, a serialized write queue, an append-only write journal, and a path allowlist. The host of obsidian-mcp-suite: the suite's other plugins publish their MCP tools through it. Governor is a separate, optional plugin that adds the human-only acceptance perimeter beside it.
author: Nelson Love
